stratagem.name: BLAZING EARTH
stratagem.lore: When faced with an onrushing horde, the Forgefather’s warriors set fire to the earth beneath their feet, impeding their advance and throwing them into confusion.
stratagem.when: Start of your opponent’s Charge phase.
stratagem.target: One friendly unengaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit equipped with one or more Torrent/Melta weapons.
stratagem.effect: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. That enemy unit has -1 to charge rolls.

stratagem.name: WRATH AND RUIN
stratagem.lore: Having drawn their enemies in, Space Marine battle-brothers fall back and open fire at point- blank range before thundering forward to put any survivors to death.
stratagem.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit.
stratagem.effect: The assault doctrine or tactical doctrine is active for your unit, until the start of your next Command phase.

stratagem.name: FORGED IN FIRE
stratagem.lore: The Salamanders are masters of the flamer, wielding such weapons with supreme precision and utilising them even in the press of melee combat.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to shoot.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s Torrent weapons: ▪ Do not have [Blast]. ▪ Have [Close-Quarters]. ▪ Have +1 A.

stratagem.name: IMMOLATION PROTOCOLS
stratagem.lore: Salvo after salvo of burning promethium unleashed in synchronised waves will leave almost any foe as smouldering ash.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack.
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s ranged [TORRENT] attacks have +1 AP.

stratagem.name: CRUCIBLE OF BATTLE
stratagem.lore: Only where the enemy can be faced eye to eye can a Space Marine be truly tested.
stratagem.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY unit is selected to attack an enemy unit within 6".
stratagem.effect: Your unit’s attacks can: ▪ Re-roll hit rolls of 1. ▪ Re-roll wound rolls of 1.

stratagem.name: BURNING VENGEANCE
stratagem.lore: To open fire on warriors of the Salamanders is merely to invite one’s own swift destruction.
stratagem.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot a friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagem.target: One friendly ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit embarked within that ADEPTUS ASTARTES TRANSPORT unit.
stratagem.effect: Your ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit can: ▪ Make a disembark move. ▪ Shoot using normal shooting, but when doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.
